texts.li: [tame] The faith holds the {THING} sacred, and {A_nameDef} says the colony has never once kept a day for them. {A_nameDef} would carry food out to {X_nameDef} and have everyone gather round it for an afternoon, the work set down.

[wild] {A_nameDef} has seen {X_nameDef} out at the edge of the colony's land, and the faith holds the {THING} sacred. {A_nameDef} would carry food out to it and have everyone gather quietly nearby for the afternoon, as a day for the sacred animals.
[colony:Traditional] Where {A_nameDef} grew up, the sacred animals had a day of their own each year. The faith holds the {THING} sacred here too, and {X_nameDef} is out there now.

li.label: Keep a day for them
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried food out to {X_nameDef}, and everyone gathered near it through the afternoon, talking quietly, the work left for tomorrow.

li.label: Leave food out, and back to work
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried food out to {X_nameDef} and left it there, and the day went on like any other.

li.label: Not this year
li.outcome: No day for the sacred animals this year. {A_nameDef} took it quietly.
